title: Shopping
description: Buy things, ask the price, and push back on it.

questions.sentence: Dada, eta koto?
options: Eta ponchash taka.
Eta amar dokan.
Ami bajare jachhi.
questions.correctAnswer: Eta ponchash taka.
questions.translatedSentence: This is fifty rupees.

questions.sentence: Etar daam koto?
options: What is the price of this?
Where is this shop?
Do you want this one?
questions.correctAnswer: What is the price of this?

questions.sentence: Apnar dokane mishti ache?
options: Hyan, mishti ache.
Na, ami mishti khai na.
Mishti khub bhalo.
questions.correctAnswer: Hyan, mishti ache.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, we have sweets.

questions.sentence: Ami ekta jama chai.
options: I want a shirt.
I have a shirt.
I am wearing a shirt.
questions.correctAnswer: I want a shirt.

questions.sentence: Ki chai, didi?
options: Amake ek kilo aloo din.
Ami dokane kaj kori.
Apnar dokan khub boro.
questions.correctAnswer: Amake ek kilo aloo din.
questions.translatedSentence: Please give me a kilo of potatoes.

questions.sentence: Ei macher daam beshi.
options: This fish is too expensive.
This fish is very fresh.
I want to buy some fish.
questions.correctAnswer: This fish is too expensive.

questions.sentence: Cha koto kore?
options: Dosh taka kore.
Cha khub gorom.
Ami cha khabo.
questions.correctAnswer: Dosh taka kore.
questions.translatedSentence: Ten rupees each.

questions.sentence: Eta khub dami.
options: This is very expensive.
This is very cheap.
This is very big.
questions.correctAnswer: This is very expensive.

questions.sentence: Aar kichhu lagbe?
options: Na, aar kichhu lagbe na.
Hyan, ami bhalo achi.
Na, dokan bondho.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, aar kichhu lagbe na.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I do not need anything else.

questions.sentence: Dada, apnar kachhe tatka mach ache?
options: Hyan, aaj tatka rui ache.
Na, ami mach dhori na.
Mach ranna korte samay lage.
questions.correctAnswer: Hyan, aaj tatka rui ache.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, we have fresh rohu today.

questions.sentence: Amake adha kilo chini din.
options: Please give me half a kilo of sugar.
Please give me two kilos of sugar.
I do not need any sugar today.
questions.correctAnswer: Please give me half a kilo of sugar.

questions.sentence: Ei jamata dekhte pari?
options: Hyan, dekhun.
Na, ami dekhchhi na.
Jamata amar bhalo lage.
questions.correctAnswer: Hyan, dekhun.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, please take a look.

questions.sentence: Apnar dokane aro boro byag ache?
options: Do you have a bigger bag in your shop?
Is your shop bigger than that one?
Do you sell bags in your shop?
questions.correctAnswer: Do you have a bigger bag in your shop?

questions.sentence: Apni ki khunjchhen?
options: Ami ekta lal shari khunjchhi.
Ami dokane dariye achi.
Ami kichhu kinbo na.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami ekta lal shari khunjchhi.
questions.translatedSentence: I am looking for a red saree.

questions.sentence: Ei mishti gulo ki aajker?
options: Are these sweets made today?
Are these sweets made with milk?
Are these the sweets you like?
questions.correctAnswer: Are these sweets made today?

questions.sentence: Amar ek packet cha lagbe.
options: Konta neben, Darjeeling na Assam?
Cha ekhane pawa jay na.
Ami cha khete bhalobasi.
questions.correctAnswer: Konta neben, Darjeeling na Assam?
questions.translatedSentence: Which will you take, Darjeeling or Assam?

questions.sentence: Bhai, tumi ki amake ekta thole dite parbe?
options: Brother, can you give me a cloth bag?
Brother, can you show me a cloth bag?
Brother, do you want to buy a cloth bag?
questions.correctAnswer: Brother, can you give me a cloth bag?

questions.sentence: Ei rong ta apnar pochhondo hoyeche?
options: Na, amake nil ta dekhan.
Hyan, ei dokan ta bhalo.
Na, ami ekhon jachhi.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, amake nil ta dekhan.
questions.translatedSentence: No, show me the blue one.

questions.sentence: Ei shari tar daam dui hajar taka.
options: Eto daam? Ektu kom korun.
Bah, khub sasta.
Thik ache, ami duto nebo.
questions.correctAnswer: Eto daam? Ektu kom korun.
questions.translatedSentence: That much? Please bring it down a little.

questions.sentence: Daam ta ektu kom korun, ami niyomito khodder.
options: Lower the price a little, I am a regular customer.
The price is low here, and I come quite often.
I will pay less than the regular customers do.
questions.correctAnswer: Lower the price a little, I am a regular customer.

questions.sentence: Ektu kom hobe na?
options: Na dada, eta ekdam daam.
Na dada, aaj dokan bondho.
Hyan, ami aro beshi nebo.
questions.correctAnswer: Na dada, eta ekdam daam.
questions.translatedSentence: No, this is the fixed price.

questions.sentence: Eto beshi daam dite parbo na.
options: I cannot pay that much.
I do not want to buy this.
The price is not written here.
questions.correctAnswer: I cannot pay that much.

questions.sentence: Apni koto dite parben?
options: Ami eksho taka dite pari.
Ami dokane taka rakhi.
Amar kachhe taka nei.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami eksho taka dite pari.
questions.translatedSentence: I can pay a hundred rupees.

questions.sentence: Onno dokane ei jinis ta aro sasta.
options: This same thing is cheaper at the other shop.
The other shop sells much better things.
I bought this thing at another shop.
questions.correctAnswer: This same thing is cheaper at the other shop.

questions.sentence: Duto nile ki kom hobe?
options: Duto nile ponchash taka kom debo.
Duto nile beshi daam hobe.
Ami duto dokan chalai.
questions.correctAnswer: Duto nile ponchash taka kom debo.
questions.translatedSentence: If you take two, I will reduce it by fifty rupees.

questions.sentence: Thik ache, tinsho takatei din.
options: All right, give it to me for three hundred then.
All right, I will come back for it later.
Fine, three hundred rupees is far too little.
questions.correctAnswer: All right, give it to me for three hundred then.

questions.sentence: Shesh daam koto bolun.
options: Char sho taka, ekdam shesh daam.
Apni je daam bolben sei daam.
Amar dokan sokal theke khola.
questions.correctAnswer: Char sho taka, ekdam shesh daam.
questions.translatedSentence: Four hundred rupees, and that is my final price.

questions.sentence: Ei jama ta apnar maap hobe?
options: Na, eta ektu chhoto hochhe.
Hyan, jama ta lal ronger.
Na, ami jama pori na.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, eta ektu chhoto hochhe.
questions.translatedSentence: No, this one is a bit too small for me.

questions.sentence: Amake ek kilo peyaj aar adha kilo tomato din.
options: Give me a kilo of onions and half a kilo of tomatoes.
Give me half a kilo of onions and a kilo of tomatoes.
I need onions and tomatoes from the market today.
questions.correctAnswer: Give me a kilo of onions and half a kilo of tomatoes.

questions.sentence: Koto ta chal neben?
options: Panch kilo chal din.
Chal ta khub bhalo.
Ami chal ranna korchi.
questions.correctAnswer: Panch kilo chal din.
questions.translatedSentence: Please give me five kilos of rice.

questions.sentence: Aro boro maap er juto ache?
options: Do you have these shoes in a bigger size?
Are these shoes bigger than those ones?
Do you have any cheaper shoes here?
questions.correctAnswer: Do you have these shoes in a bigger size?

questions.sentence: Ei panjabi ta boro maap e ache?
options: Hyan ache, kintu shudhu sada ronge.
Hyan, chhoto maap ta beshi dami.
Na, boro dokan ta bondho.
questions.correctAnswer: Hyan ache, kintu shudhu sada ronge.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes we have it, but only in white.

questions.sentence: Adha kilo mishti hole cholbe, beshi lagbe na.
options: Half a kilo of sweets will do, I do not need more.
I need more than half a kilo of sweets today.
The sweets are now half the price they were.
questions.correctAnswer: Half a kilo of sweets will do, I do not need more.

questions.sentence: Koto ta dudh lagbe apnar?
options: Ek litre dudh dile hobe.
Dudh ta ektu gorom korun.
Ami roj dudh khai.
questions.correctAnswer: Ek litre dudh dile hobe.
questions.translatedSentence: One litre of milk will do.

questions.sentence: Ei macher tukro gulo aro chhoto kore katun.
options: Please cut these pieces of fish a little smaller.
Please give me the smaller fish from that basket.
These pieces of fish are far too small for me.
questions.correctAnswer: Please cut these pieces of fish a little smaller.

questions.sentence: Juto ta paye thik hochhe?
options: Ektu tight lagchhe, ek maap boro din.
Juto duto khub dami.
Ami juto ta kal nebo.
questions.correctAnswer: Ektu tight lagchhe, ek maap boro din.
questions.translatedSentence: It is a little tight, please give me one size bigger.

questions.sentence: Sob miliye char sho ponchash taka holo.
options: Ei nin, panch sho taka.
Ami char sho taka niyechi.
Char sho ponchash ta khub kom.
questions.correctAnswer: Ei nin, panch sho taka.
questions.translatedSentence: Here you are, five hundred rupees.

questions.sentence: Apnar kachhe khuchro ache? Amar kachhe bhangti nei.
options: Do you have small change? I have none on me.
Do you need small change? I have plenty on me.
I have small change, but you do not need it.
questions.correctAnswer: Do you have small change? I have none on me.

questions.sentence: Dukkhito, amader ekhane card chole na.
options: Thik ache, tahole nagade dichhi.
Bah, tahole card tai debo.
Amar kachhe card ache, taka nei.
questions.correctAnswer: Thik ache, tahole nagade dichhi.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, in that case I will pay in cash.

questions.sentence: Bakita taka ferot din, ami ekhoni berobo.
options: Please give me the rest of the money back, I am leaving now.
Please return the money tomorrow, I am rather busy now.
Keep the rest of the money, I am leaving right now.
questions.correctAnswer: Please give me the rest of the money back, I am leaving now.

questions.sentence: Ekta byag deben? Amar kachhe thole nei.
options: Byag er jonno tin taka beshi lagbe.
Amader dokane thole bikri hoy na.
Byag ta khub bhari hoye geche.
questions.correctAnswer: Byag er jonno tin taka beshi lagbe.
questions.translatedSentence: The bag will cost three rupees extra.

questions.sentence: Ei eksho takar not ta bhangti kore deben?
options: Could you break this hundred rupee note for me?
Could you give me a hundred rupee note instead?
Is this hundred rupee note a real one?
questions.correctAnswer: Could you break this hundred rupee note for me?

questions.sentence: Rosid ta niye jan, dorkar hote pare.
options: Hyan, rosid ta amake diye din.
Na, ami taka diye diyechi.
Rosid ta apni rekhe din.
questions.correctAnswer: Hyan, rosid ta amake diye din.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, please hand me the receipt.

questions.sentence: Dosh taka kom porlo, kal diye debo.
options: I am ten rupees short, I will give it tomorrow.
The price came down by ten rupees today.
I paid ten rupees more than I had to.
questions.correctAnswer: I am ten rupees short, I will give it tomorrow.

questions.sentence: Apni ki thik taka diyechen?
options: Na, ami eksho taka beshi diyechi.
Hyan, ami taka ganini.
Na, amar kachhe taka ache.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, ami eksho taka beshi diyechi.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I gave a hundred rupees too much.

questions.sentence: Ami gotokal ei juto ta kinechilam, kintu eta amar paye hochhe na.
options: Rosid thakle amra bodle dite pari.
Juto ta bhalo, apni eta i rakhun.
Amra kinte pari, kintu daam kom debo.
questions.correctAnswer: Rosid thakle amra bodle dite pari.
questions.translatedSentence: If you have the receipt, we can exchange it.

questions.sentence: Ei jama ta ekbar dhuyei rong uthe geche, tai ami ferot dite chai.
options: The colour ran the first time I washed this shirt, so I want to return it.
I washed this shirt once and it still looks new, so I will keep it.
This shirt has a lovely colour, but I would like a different one.
questions.correctAnswer: The colour ran the first time I washed this shirt, so I want to return it.

questions.sentence: Apni ki taka ferot chan, na onno jinis neben?
options: Taka ferot pele bhalo hoy, karon amar aar kichhu lagbe na.
Ami taka diye diyechi, tai aar kichhu bolbo na.
Onno dokan theke ami ei jinis kinini.
questions.correctAnswer: Taka ferot pele bhalo hoy, karon amar aar kichhu lagbe na.
questions.translatedSentence: A refund would be better, because I do not need anything else.

questions.sentence: Kal je mishti niyechilam ta tatka chilo na.
options: The sweets I took yesterday were not fresh.
The sweets I took yesterday were very fresh.
I did not take any sweets from here yesterday.
questions.correctAnswer: The sweets I took yesterday were not fresh.

questions.sentence: Ei dokane daam ektu beshi, na?
options: Hyan, kintu ekhankar jinis onek bhalo.
Na, ami ei dokane asi na.
Na, ei dokan ta gotokal khuleche.
questions.correctAnswer: Hyan, kintu ekhankar jinis onek bhalo.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, but the things here are much better.

questions.sentence: Jodi aaj daam kom na hoy, tahole ami onno dokane chole jabo.
options: If the price does not come down today, I will go to another shop.
If the price comes down today, I will still go to another shop.
Since the price is low today, I will not go to another shop.
questions.correctAnswer: If the price does not come down today, I will go to another shop.

questions.sentence: Ei ghori ta kaj korche na, ami ki eta bodle nite pari?
options: Ek soptaher moddhe hole bodle deoa jay.
Amra ghori sarai na, shudhu bikri kori.
Ghori ta apni kal abar niye asben.
questions.correctAnswer: Ek soptaher moddhe hole bodle deoa jay.
questions.translatedSentence: If it is within a week, it can be exchanged.

questions.sentence: Tumi jodi amar songe asho, ami tomake sasta dokan ta dekhabo.
options: If you come with me, I will show you the cheaper shop.
If I come with you, you can show me the cheaper shop.
Come with me and buy something from the cheaper shop.
questions.correctAnswer: If you come with me, I will show you the cheaper shop.

questions.sentence: Aar kono osubidha hole amake bolben.
options: Nishchoi bolbo, apnara khub bhalo byabohar korechen.
Osubidha ta ekhoni thik kore din.
Ami ekhane kaj kori na, ami khodder.
questions.correctAnswer: Nishchoi bolbo, apnara khub bhalo byabohar korechen.
questions.translatedSentence: I certainly will; you have treated me very well.
